verdict.rationale: A state business registry could reasonably publish an API spec, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe shows only a keyless JSON data endpoint on the Socrata open-data platform. That is a host-platform data API, not a published API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
